name: Exploring Pendola Pass

steps.t: Destroy 20 ARC enemies
steps.go: Any ARC anywhere on the map counts. Small ones around the Railyard, Old Town and Loading Platforms are easy pickings.

steps.t: Search the control room at the Cielo Sereno Observatory for power
steps.go: Go up to the observatory on the north-east mountain. In the control room, use the power console near the left outer edge.

steps.t: Use 1 Wire to patch into the antenna on top of the tallest tower in the Railyard
steps.pin: Use 1 wire to patch into the antenna on top fo the tallest tower in the railyard
steps.go: Bring a Wire. Climb the ladder on the building by the tallest Railyard tower, then zipline or hook up to the roof antenna.

steps.t: Search 3 containers inside the Commissary Supermarket
steps.go: Head into the supermarket next to the Railyard. Loot any three containers inside, not the ones outside.

notes: Any order, can span raids. Giver named only by All Things How. Reaching the tower roof needs a Zipline, Snap Hook or Grappling Hook per guides.

name: Sizing Things Up

steps.t: Take a photo of the Emperor's leg
steps.go: Stand on the bridge just east of Old Town, facing the Emperor's leg. Photograph its lower part with a camera.

steps.t: Analyse the exposed area on top of the Emperor's leg
steps.go: Go just south of Railroad Junction and climb onto the exposed leg. Hold the analyse prompt at the marked point.

steps.t: Optional: inspect the crashed probe
steps.go: Near Almatera Station there is a crashed probe you can inspect. Skip it if pressed.

steps.t: Reach the base of the Emperor
steps.pin: Reach the base of the Emperor
steps.go: Head to the front of the fallen Emperor's body near Piazza Della Rupe. Walk up to the base until it ticks off.

steps.t: Search the Buried Harvester Payload
steps.go: At the front centre of the body, search the payload half buried in snow. Pick up the ARC Conductive Coupler and stash it.

steps.t: Deliver the ARC Conductive Coupler to Celeste
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract with the coupler and hand it to Celeste.

notes: PC Gamer calls the analyse step optional; KeenGamer and Destructoid list it as required. Crashed probe is optional and mentioned only by KeenGamer. Destructoid says steps 4 onward must be done in one raid. Pin names 'Reach the base of the emperor' and 'Buried Harvester Payload' are alternative spots for steps 4 and 5.

name: Clean Hands

steps.t: Find the Nomad Camp under the Railyard
steps.pin: Find the Nomad Camp under the Railyard
steps.go: From the south-west side of the Railyard, go through the big drainage pipes underground. Follow the raised walkways to the camp.

steps.t: Search for the polluted item
steps.pin: Search for the polluted item in the Nomad camp
steps.go: In the middle of the walkways, search the yellow duffel bag by a green barrel. Put the Equatorial Sundial in your safe pocket.

steps.t: Bring the Equatorial Sundial to the top of the church in Old Town
steps.pin: Bring the Eqauatiorial Sundial to the top of the Church in Old Town
steps.go: Enter the Old Town church and climb the spiral stairs, then zipline up to the tower balcony. Interact with the railing to raise the sundial.

steps.t: Deliver the Equatorial Sundial to the Nomadic Envoy
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract by gondola and hand the sundial to the Nomadic Envoy.

notes: Single raid; bring a safe pocket augment. Guides differ on camp entrance details and on Old Town's compass direction, but steps match. PC Gamer ends at extraction rather than naming the delivery.

name: Ruins and Reverberations

steps.t: Get a Spotter Relay
steps.go: Buried City map. Destroy a Spotter, the small flyer escorting Bombardiers (also on Spaceport and the Dam), and loot its relay.

steps.t: Connect a Spotter Relay to the antenna on the Cielo Sereno Observatory roof
steps.pin: Spotter Relay on the Observatory antenna
steps.go: Climb the yellow ladder on the observatory's east wall, or hook up. Fit the relay to the antenna on the west side of the roof.

steps.t: Weld the wires in the crawlspace
steps.pin: Weld the wires in the crawlspace
steps.go: Drop through the roof hole into the control room, then through the floor gap. Turn left twice and use the wall panel.

steps.t: Activate the Spotter Relay connected to the antenna
steps.pin: Spotter Relay on the Observatory antenna
steps.go: Climb back to the roof antenna and use the activate prompt.

notes: KeenGamer lists getting the relay as its own objective; Destructoid starts at connecting it. Destructoid words step 3 as repair the wires to redirect power; pin says weld. Antenna side differs (west vs south-west). Must be done in one raid.

name: Tracks of the Beast

steps.t: Head to the Northern Tracks
steps.go: Make for the northern railway near Railroad Junction and Frozen River. Arriving ticks it off.

steps.t: Find the destroyed station
steps.go: Head back south-west to the ruined Almatera Station and step inside.

steps.t: Find and ping a Bully
steps.go: Scout the roads around Almatera Station for a Bully. Ping it from cover, no need to fight.

steps.t: Find and ping a Skulker
steps.go: Look for a low, crawling Skulker in the snowfields near the station. Ping it.

notes: Unlocks after Exploring Pendola Pass. KeenGamer alone mentions optional objectives: destroy 3 Skulkers and deliver a Skulker Targeter to Shani. Giver named only by KeenGamer.

name: Divided

steps.t: Search for the Nomad recording at the Loading Platforms
steps.pin: Nomad Recording at the Loading Platforms
steps.go: Climb to the upper level of the Loading Platforms. The recording is in the small booth on the raised deck.

steps.t: Search for the Nomad recording at the Weather Station
steps.go: Go below the observatory to the Weather Station and enter its only building. Take the recording inside.

steps.t: Search for the Nomad recording at the Dispatch Tower
steps.go: North of Almatera Station, break the ice blocking the tower door. Zipline to the top floor and grab the recording.

steps.t: Search for the Nomad recording at Almatera Station
steps.go: On the station's ground floor, go to the reception area. The recording sits on the information desk.

notes: Recordings can be collected in any order; no item to extract, free loadout works. Follows Ruins and Reverberations. Other pins with the same targets ('Search for the Nomad recording at ...', numbered '3.' and '4.' pins) are alternative spots for the same steps. Guides differ on booth side at Loading Platforms.
